## Description {#details}

<p>MatchContext can repurpose existing patterns to behave differently under a certain context.</p>


<p>For instance, <span class="doxyComputerOutput">m_Opc(ISD::ADD)</span> matches plain ADD nodes in normal circumstances, but matches VP_ADD nodes under a custom <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/vpmatchcontext">VPMatchContext</a>. This design is meant to facilitate code / pattern reusing.</p>


<p>Definition at line 29 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/codegen/sdpatternmatch-h">SDPatternMatch.h</a>.</p>
